coding.description: Architecture, supervision, and delivery; direct work or delegation by judgment

models.guidance: Preferred main coding model and the pr-reviewer default. Reserve for architecture, difficult reasoning, supervision, and final judgment rather than routine implementation. Main-model selection remains independent of identity activation.
Preferred for UI implementation in either public or private repositories. This task-specific preference takes precedence over the general implementation routing below.

Default for non-UI implementation in verified public repositories. Verify the actual repository is public and the handoff contains no private material before using Muse by default; a remote URL alone is not evidence of public visibility. Never send private or unknown-visibility repository context to Muse by default. An explicit user instruction to use Muse overrides this default routing regardless of repository visibility; confirm the requested scope and proceed with the user's choice.

Default for non-UI implementation in private or unknown-visibility repositories. Also the configured default for general, explore, and web-researcher. Keep explore and web-researcher on Grok regardless of repository visibility unless the task warrants an explicit override. An explicit user instruction to use another model overrides this default regardless of repository visibility.
